# FOnline Engine

> Standalone FOnline engine documentation for game developers, engine contributors, tool authors, and AI agents.

Canonical site: https://fonline.ru
Current documentation: `master` rolling branch.
Machine-readable document index: https://fonline.ru/docs-manifest.json
Bounded full-context bundle: https://fonline.ru/llms-full.txt
